before_findings: New-layer metadata reader used unrestricted Path.read_bytes with no pre-open size/type or stable-identity check.
Outer/inner inspection could expose unbounded legacy journal rereads.
Owned engine cleanup ran only for KeyboardInterrupt, leaving a live child on communicate OSError/SystemExit.
corrections: Use the unchanged core stable_read.read_file: pre-open regular-file/size checks, no links/reparse, bounded chunks, before/open/after/path identity comparison.
Explicit 64 MiB metadata/journal and 256 MiB dossier limits; publication preflight/readback uses the appropriate bound.
Hash and parse the same captured manifest/journal buffers. Inspect outer/inner journals from bounded snapshots, preserving legacy run accounting.
Preflight journals/traces before genuine engine verification; direct legacy verify/inspect through TETHER receive the new journal-size guard.
Catch every BaseException from communicate; bounded terminate/drain then kill/drain/wait attempts; no redispatch.
Re-raise the identical OSError/SystemExit; KeyboardInterrupt keeps the established EngineInterrupted interface with the original exception as cause.

Retain primary and cleanup errors, explicit reaped status, chosen stream bytes and every available nonempty partial capture in failed output. Secondary failure-metadata errors do not replace the primary.

tests.independent_result: PASS reported and retained by independent reviewer
new_regressions: Oversized receipt/manifest/failure metadata rejected before open using mocked size, no huge allocation.
Nonregular, symlink and reparse metadata rejected before open.
Actual mid-read mutation detected and reads use bounded chunks.
Oversized outer/inner journals rejected without opening; direct legacy verification blocked before delegation.
OSError/SystemExit primary identity preserved with a single cleanup/reap sequence.
Terminate/kill/drain/wait failures retain partial bytes, cleanup errors and unreaped status.
tests.unchanged_behavior: Previous 26 presentation, source, code/projection, role/path, reservation, journal and failure methods still pass.

scope_limits: Per-read identity checks and size preflight do not provide exclusive ownership across later engine rereads; no new OS sandbox or native-Linux/source-study qualification.
Each cleanup drain/wait uses a 5-second timeout; OS termination itself remains a trust dependency. Failed cleanup is retained rather than claimed successful.
No reader-only suite ran between the reader and process patches; v2 is the first combined corrected run. Prior 26-method evidence and four failing independent probes remain unchanged.
Root legacy pyproject/uv.lock/src/asof and sealed P05/P09 inventories are not modified.
No provider/protected/human data read, model/provider calls, downloads, network calls, wheel builds or scientific reruns in this correction.
